rhino.name: Rhino's River Guard
rhino.line: We secure the middle ford and hunt their riders.

tiger.name: Tiger's River Ambition
tiger.line: Secure the western crossing and seek a wary alliance.

kite.name: Kite's River Guardians
kite.line: Hold the East Ford; wait for the Tiger to stumble.

orchid.name: Orchid's Patient Bloom
orchid.line: Hold our ground, secure the fords, and watch the enemy's movements.
